messages.text: Why are all your globes defected and horribly misaligned?

I'm sorry to hear you're unhappy — that's not the experience we want anyone to have. Are you referring to a specific globe you've already received, or something you noticed on a product page? If you've got an order with a defect or alignment issue, I'd like to get that sorted out properly.

Could you share your order number and the email used on the order so I can look into it?
The coo promised an inspection and it came horribly misaligned. I want to know why?

I understand the frustration, and I want to get this looked at properly. I'm not able to verify or act on promises made outside this chat, but I can make sure the owner sees exactly what happened. Could you give me your order number and the email used on the order?
I couldn't find an order matching that number and email together. Could you double-check both and send them again?

I'm not able to tell which part isn't matching, just that number and email together don't bring up an order. Could you double check the email on the order and try again? If it still doesn't turn up, I'll get the owner directly involved with what you've told me so far.
Whatever you don’t want to help that’s fine.
I do want to help — I just can't pull up order details without a match. Let me get this straight to the owner with what you've shared so they can sort it out directly.
Handed to the team · Complaint about misaligned/defective globe, claims COO promised inspection
The owner now has this conversation, including the order number and details, and will follow up with you by email — usually within one business day. Thanks for your patience.
